parsed_body.title: Surfing Courses and Lessons
parsed_body.subtitle: Surf Holic
parsed_body.description:
Surf Holic’s “Surfing Course”
- What is surfing? It is a course designed for those who want to enjoy marine leisure and sports

Surf Holic’s “5-Session Surfing Course”
- Surf Holic’s exclusive 5-session surfing course is designed for beginners to acquire basic skills for safely enjoying surfing alone. As part of this course, you will be able to learn safety tips, surfing rules, and surf culture.

Surf Holic’s “Advanced Surfing Course”
- This advanced surfing course is for intermediate or even advanced surfers. It consists of a one-point lesson and a theoretical surf class so that the more experienced can hone their surfing techniques and respond to waves of different intensities.

Surf Holic’s “Surf Instructor Development Course”
- This is a surf instructor development course designed for those who plan to become surf instructors at a Surf Holic franchise or any other surf facility.
